description: This PHP class 'EmployeeGender' defines a filter field for employee gender within a reporting context. It extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable', and provides methods for adding a gender filter to a query, returning entity aliases, and converting the value to an array with label.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees by gender in reports, allowing query modifications and value normalization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a gender filter condition to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in query conditions, here 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the filter value to an array with 'id' and 'label', where label is 'Male' or 'Female' based on the value.
